questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 9$ in substitution method, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0$.
A data set recorded for substitution method consists of the four values $\{10, 14, 18, 24\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $10 + 14 + 18 + 24 = 66$, and dividing by $4$ gives $16.5$.
